description: This file defines the CommandProcessingService interface in the org.apache.fineract.commands.service package, specifying methods for executing commands and validating rollback commands within the Fineract system.

classes.name: CommandProcessingService
classes.description: An interface defining methods for processing commands and validating rollback permissions within the Fineract system.

methods.name: executeCommand
methods.description: Executes a command wrapped in a CommandWrapper with an associated JsonCommand, returning the result of the command processing.

methods.name: validateRollbackCommand
methods.description: Validates whether a rollback command is permissible for a given user.
